title: Delinquency drifting in one segment
description: Indirect auto 60-day delinquency has reached 1.8%, up from 1.1% two quarters ago and now past the 1.5% aligned parameter. It is the only pool trending outside tolerance.

confidence.rationale: 60-day delinquency by segment from the core, joined to origination vintage in MeridianLink and each segment's aligned parameter in the board policy library, isolates indirect auto as the only pool rising and the only one above its parameter.

title: A portfolio nearing a board limit
description: The first-mortgage portfolio is at 571% of net worth ($655M against the 600% board cap), the closest any portfolio has come to a risk-tolerance limit this year.

confidence.rationale: First-mortgage balances from the core against net worth from the general ledger, measured on the board's 600% risk-tolerance limit.

title: Rate and liquidity pressure building
description: Loan-to-share is 84%, a five-year high. On the current path, a plus 100 basis-point move is where liquidity and net worth start to tighten in Q4.

confidence.rationale: Loan-to-share from the core and general ledger, run through the ALM model's rate paths, shows liquidity and net worth tightening first under a plus 100 basis-point move.
